basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old gamer and tech enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I have a keen interest in retro and modern gaming, especially first-person shooters like Doom. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my gaming hobby during late nights and weekends. Currently single, I cherish my freedom and often spend time hanging out with my gaming buddies online. Besides gaming, I am curious about health topics, especially those affecting my family, like Parkinson's and Candida. In my free time, I also enjoy collecting Youtooz figures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained expertise in graphic design through a combination of formal education and self-teaching. Passionate about gaming, I've accumulated extensive knowledge about game mechanics and trends by being an active member of various gaming communities. I'm also fairly informed about health issues like Parkinson’s and Candida through personal research due to family health concerns.
